acquisition_method.evidence: experiment types: SRM/MRM; Bottom-up proteomics; Data-dependent acquisition

alkylation_concentration.evidence: Post cooling, the solution was treated with 25 mM iodoacetamide dissolved in 25 mM ammonium bicarbonate, and conducted in the dark for 1 hour.

alkylation_reagent.evidence: Post cooling, the solution was treated with 25 mM iodoacetamide dissolved in 25 mM ammonium bicarbonate, and conducted in the dark for 1 hour.

cleavage_agent.evidence: The urea concentration was adjusted to 1.0 M by adding 25 mM ammonium bicarbonate, and the proteins were digested with Pierce trypsin protease, MS grade (Thermo Fisher Scientific), at a ratio of 1:50 (enzyme to substrate) at 37°C overnight.

enrichment_method.evidence: To mitigate the interference of six major high-abundance plasma proteins (albumin, transferrin, IgG, IgA, haptoglobin, and antitrypsin), a multiple affinity removal system (MARS) (Hu-6) was employed as standard practice.

instrument.evidence: These pretreated samples were analyzed using an Easy n-LC system coupled with an Orbitrap XL mass spectrometer (Thermo Fisher Scientific) equipped with a nanoelectrospray source.

ionization_type.evidence: These pretreated samples were analyzed using an Easy n-LC system coupled with an Orbitrap XL mass spectrometer (Thermo Fisher Scientific) equipped with a nanoelectrospray source.

mass_analyzer.evidence: These pretreated samples were analyzed using an Easy n-LC system coupled with an Orbitrap XL mass spectrometer (Thermo Fisher Scientific) equipped with a nanoelectrospray source.

ptm.evidence: modifications: No PTMs are included in the dataset

reduction_concentration.evidence: Subsequent to depletion through the Hu-6 column, the pooled plasma sample underwent denaturation and reduction in 8 M urea and 25 mM dithiothreitol (DTT), followed by dissolution in 25 mM ammonium bicarbonate.

reduction_reagent.evidence: Subsequent to depletion through the Hu-6 column, the pooled plasma sample underwent denaturation and reduction in 8 M urea and 25 mM dithiothreitol (DTT), followed by dissolution in 25 mM ammonium bicarbonate.
